description: Use when you need historical exchange rates, a historical FX rate series, forex history or a currency trend. Do not use for rates older than 90 days, live quotes or crypto (one ECB rate per business day). Returns JSON with historical exchange rates: 90 days of daily ECB euro reference rates (free at ecb.europa.eu) for up to 10 currencies, rebased to any base as cross rates, with min, max and percent change for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.005 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

base.description: Base currency, ISO 4217 (EUR when omitted), e.g. USD

days.description: Calendar days back from endDate, 1 to 90 (90 when omitted; ignored with startDate), e.g. 30

endDate.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (latest ECB day when omitted), e.g. 2026-09-30

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 90 days, e.g. 2026-09-01

symbols.description: Currencies to return, ISO 4217, up to 10, e.g. ["USD", "BRL"]

name: blackwood_fx_history
title: Historical exchange rates
